---
title: "Discovery Plots"
subtitle: "Statewide and parish-level trends before and after cell phone bans in Louisiana and South Carolina"
page-layout: full
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
  echo: false
  fig-width: 9
  fig-height: 6
  out-width: "100%"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(httr)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Download and prepare Louisiana data
la_files <- c(
  "2018-19" = "https://doe.louisiana.gov/docs/default-source/test-results/2019-state-lea-leap-2025-mastery-summary.xlsx?sfvrsn=fed19c1f_0",
  "2021-22" = "https://doe.louisiana.gov/docs/default-source/test-results/2022-state-lea-leap-2025-mastery-summary.xlsx?sfvrsn=2e1a6218_0",
  "2022-23" = "https://doe.louisiana.gov/docs/default-source/test-results/2023-state-lea-leap-2025-mastery-summary.xlsx?sfvrsn=8d286018_0",
  "2023-24" = "https://doe.louisiana.gov/docs/default-source/test-results/2024-state-lea-leap-2025-mastery-summary.xlsx?sfvrsn=57f27e7b_8",
  "2024-25" = "https://doe.louisiana.gov/docs/default-source/data-management/2025-state-lea-leap-2025-mastery-summary.xlsx?sfvrsn=dcd8503e_7"
)

data_dir <- if (dir.exists("data/raw/louisiana")) {
  "data/raw/louisiana"
} else if (dir.exists("../data/raw/louisiana")) {
  "../data/raw/louisiana"
} else {
  dir.create("data/raw/louisiana", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  "data/raw/louisiana"
}

download_la_file <- function(url, school_year) {
  dest <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("leap_mastery_", school_year, ".xlsx"))
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    resp <- GET(url, write_disk(dest, overwrite = TRUE), user_agent("Mozilla/5.0"))
    stop_for_status(resp)
  }
  dest
}

la_paths <- imap(la_files, download_la_file)

la_sheet_map <- c(
  "2018-19" = "ELA, Math and Social Studies",
  "2021-22" = "All Subjects",
  "2022-23" = "All Subjects",
  "2023-24" = "All Subjects",
  "2024-25" = "All Subjects"
)

clean_la_file <- function(path, sheet_name, year1, year2) {
  raw <- read_excel(path, sheet = sheet_name, skip = 3)
  names(raw)[1:2] <- c("system_code", "system_name")
  names(raw)[3:5] <- c(paste0("mastery_g3_8_", year1), paste0("mastery_g3_8_", year2), "change_g3_8")
  names(raw)[6:8] <- c(paste0("mastery_g3_12_", year1), paste0("mastery_g3_12_", year2), "change_g3_12")
  raw %>%
    select(-starts_with("change_")) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("mastery_"), names_to = c("grade_band", "year"), names_pattern = "mastery_(g3_8|g3_12)_(\\d{4})", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(value = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value)), year = as.integer(year)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = grade_band, values_from = value)
}

la_year_pairs <- list(
  "2018-19" = c(2018, 2019),
  "2021-22" = c(2021, 2022),
  "2022-23" = c(2022, 2023),
  "2023-24" = c(2023, 2024),
  "2024-25" = c(2024, 2025)
)

la_long_list <- imap(la_year_pairs, function(yrs, key) {
  clean_la_file(la_paths[[key]], sheet_name = la_sheet_map[[key]], year1 = yrs[1], year2 = yrs[2])
})

la_panel <- bind_rows(la_long_list) %>%
  distinct(system_code, year, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(system_code, year)

la_panel_clean <- la_panel |>
  mutate(
    system_name = stringr::str_to_title(system_name),
    period = if_else(year <= 2024, "pre_ban", "post_ban"),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("pre_ban", "post_ban"))
  )

la_statewide <- la_panel_clean |> filter(system_code == "LA")
la_parish <- la_panel_clean |> filter(system_code != "LA")

la_grades_long <- la_statewide |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(g3_8, g3_12), names_to = "grade_group", values_to = "pct_mastery") |>
  mutate(
    grade_label = case_when(
      grade_group == "g3_8" ~ "Grades 3-8 (Elementary & Middle)",
      grade_group == "g3_12" ~ "All Grades / High School EOC"
    )
  )

la_hs_subject_long <- tibble(
  year = rep(c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025), 2),
  subject = c(rep("English (English I & II)", 5), rep("Math (Algebra I & Geometry)", 5)),
  pct_proficient = c(
    40.0, 42.0, 43.0, 43.0, 43.0,
    27.0, 30.0, 32.0, 32.0, 34.0
  )
)

# South Carolina data
sc_statewide <- tibble(
  year = c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025),
  g3_8 = c(41.5, 44.7, 49.6, 50.1, 50.1),
  period = c("pre_ban", "pre_ban", "pre_ban", "pre_ban", "post_ban")
)

sc_grades_long <- tibble(
  year = rep(c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025), 2),
  grade_group = c(rep("elem", 5), rep("middle", 5)),
  grade_label = c(rep("Elementary (Grades 3-5)", 5), rep("Middle School (Grades 6-8)", 5)),
  pct_meets = c(
    45.2, 48.6, 53.1, 55.5, 55.2,
    37.8, 40.8, 46.1, 44.7, 45.0
  )
)

sc_hs_subject_long <- tibble(
  year = rep(c(2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025), 2),
  subject = c(rep("English (English II)", 5), rep("Math (Algebra 1)", 5)),
  pct_proficient = c(
    71.2, 73.8, 75.4, 76.1, 75.8,
    53.4, 56.1, 58.7, 59.2, 59.0
  )
)
```

## Overall Statewide Performance Trends

::: {layout-ncol=2}
```{r}
#| label: fig-la-statewide-trend
#| fig-cap: "Louisiana Statewide LEAP Performance (Warm Palette)"

ggplot(la_statewide, aes(x = year, y = g3_8)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2024.6, linetype = "dashed", color = "#c0392b", linewidth = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 2024.6, y = max(la_statewide$g3_8, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = "Ban effective\n(Aug 2024)", hjust = -0.05, size = 4.5, color = "#c0392b", fontface = "italic") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.3, color = "#d35400") +
  geom_point(size = 4.5, color = "#d35400") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = la_statewide$year) +
  labs(
    x = "Year (spring testing)",
    y = "% Proficient (Grades 3-8)",
    title = "Louisiana Statewide LEAP Performance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "#7e2a0c"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## Pre-Ban Trend Extrapolations

::: {layout-ncol=2}
```{r}
#| label: fig-la-preban-trendline
#| fig-cap: "Louisiana Pre-Ban Trend vs Actual (Warm Palette)"

pre_ban_data <- la_statewide |> filter(year <= 2024)
lm_pre <- lm(g3_8 ~ year, data = pre_ban_data)

trend_df <- tibble(
  year = seq(2021, 2025, by = 0.1),
  g3_8_fitted = predict(lm_pre, newdata = tibble(year = seq(2021, 2025, by = 0.1)))
)

proj_2025 <- predict(lm_pre, newdata = tibble(year = 2025))
actual_2025 <- la_statewide |> filter(year == 2025) |> pull(g3_8)

la_statewide_labeled <- la_statewide |>
  mutate(
    nudge_x = case_when(
      year == 2021 ~ -0.12,
      year == 2022 ~ 0,
      year == 2023 ~ 0,
      year == 2024 ~ -0.15,
      year == 2025 ~ 0.15
    ),
    nudge_y = case_when(
      year == 2021 ~ -0.5,
      year == 2022 ~ 0.6,
      year == 2023 ~ -0.5,
      year == 2024 ~ 0.6,
      year == 2025 ~ -0.5
    )
  )

ggplot(la_statewide_labeled, aes(x = year, y = g3_8)) +
  geom_line(
    data = trend_df, 
    aes(x = year, y = g3_8_fitted),
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "#e67e22", 
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    x = 2025, xend = 2025, 
    y = actual_2025, yend = proj_2025,
    color = "#c0392b", 
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 2025.06, y = (actual_2025 + proj_2025) / 2,
    label = sprintf("-%.1f pp below trend", proj_2025 - actual_2025),
    hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = "#c0392b"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2024.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "#d35400") +
  geom_point(aes(color = period), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("pre_ban" = "#e67e22", "post_ban" = "#c0392b"),
    labels = c("pre_ban" = "Pre-Ban", "post_ban" = "Post-Ban")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2021:2025, limits = c(2020.8, 2025.8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(27.5, 37), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Louisiana: Trend vs. Projection",
    x = "Spring Testing Year",
    y = "% Mastery+ (Grades 3-8)",
    color = "Period"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "#7e2a0c"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-sc-preban-trendline

ggplot(sc_statewide, aes(x = year, y = g3_8)) +
  geom_line(
    data = sc_trend_df, 
    aes(x = year, y = g3_8_fitted),
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "#3498db", 
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    x = 2025, xend = 2025,

    hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = "#1b4f72"
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2024.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "#2980b9") +
  geom_point(aes(color = period), size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("pre_ban" = "#3498db", "post_ban" = "#1b4f72"),
    labels = c("pre_ban" = "Pre-Ban", "post_ban" = "Post-Ban")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2021:2025, limits = c(2020.8, 2025.8)) +

  labs(
    title = "South Carolina: Trend vs. Projection",
    x = "Spring Testing Year",
    y = "% Meets or Exceeds (Grades 3-8)",
    color = "Period"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "#1b4f72"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

## Combined State & District Distribution (Boxplot + Scatterplot)

```{r}
#| label: fig-combined-boxplot-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Combined boxplot and scatterplot distributions comparing pre- and post-ban proficiency for Louisiana (warm palette) and South Carolina (cold palette)."

data_path_sc_dist <- if (file.exists("data/clean/sc_district_model_clean.csv")) {
  "data/clean/sc_district_model_clean.csv"
} else {
  "../data/clean/sc_district_model_clean.csv"
}

la_district_df <- la_parish |>
  filter(!is.na(g3_8)) |>
  mutate(
    state = "Louisiana",
    period_label = if_else(period == "pre_ban", "Pre-Ban", "Post-Ban"),
    period_label = factor(period_label, levels = c("Pre-Ban", "Post-Ban")),
    score = g3_8
  )

sc_district_df <- readr::read_csv(data_path_sc_dist, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(g3_8_all_subjects)) |>
  mutate(
    state = "South Carolina",
    period_label = if_else(period == "pre_ban", "Pre-Ban", "Post-Ban"),
    period_label = factor(period_label, levels = c("Pre-Ban", "Post-Ban")),
    score = g3_8_all_subjects
  )

combined_dist_df <- bind_rows(
  la_district_df |> select(state, period_label, score),
  sc_district_df |> select(state, period_label, score)
)

ggplot(combined_dist_df, aes(x = period_label, y = score, fill = state, color = state)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.45, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.45) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.45), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.35, shape = 16) +
  facet_wrap(~ state, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Louisiana" = "#e67e22", "South Carolina" = "#3498db")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Louisiana" = "#9e3606", "South Carolina" = "#1b4f72")) +
  labs(
    title = "Pre- vs. Post-Ban Proficiency Distributions",
    subtitle = "Overlaying Parish/District Scatterplot Points on Boxplots for Louisiana (Warm) and South Carolina (Cold)",
    x = "Cell Phone Policy Period",
    y = "% Proficient (Grades 3-8, All Subjects)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
